items.title: Jonah Coleman: Works with starters in warmups
items.text:
Coleman received the first rep with the starters during warmups before Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

items.title: Breece Hall: Looks like Sunday starter
items.text:

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Not with starters in warmups

items.title: Tyler Shough: Still has glove on non-throwing hand
items.text:
